verseText: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.
meaning: Jesus promised that the Holy Spirit would give us power to share the good news, beginning nearby and spreading through the whole world.
